title: 101 visual themes with theme picker
what_it_does: 101 theme sheets (data storytelling, metaphor, type, era, material, light, character, camera). Each has a summary, look, component kit, motion plan and per-theme story; pick_themes.py shortlists by tone/audience and skips the last five films' themes.
when_to_use: Choosing a concept for a new video; 10 themes are data-story ones (Sankey, bar race, Rosling bubbles, nightingale rose, streamgraph, hex cartogram).
why: The sheets are static SVG/HTML concept boards, not runnable compositions, so they are ideas to build from. Ship only the JSON data (about 100 small files) and the picker; leave the 12 MB of thumbnails.
